create_dictionary_load: load a dictionary from a text file with symbol and count pairs
build_dictionary_finalize: finalize a dictionary by sorting symbols by frequency and applying a threshold
create_dictionary_add_symbol: add a word symbol to the dictionary with an optional count
test_dictionary_string: test converting a tensor of token indices back to a human-readable string
review_dictionary_save: review saving the dictionary to a text file with symbols and their counts
